Hero.naglowek: You do the talking — Catherly keeps track of contacts and results.
Hero.podtytul: Catherly is a system for running your own direct selling — contacts, content, team, and results in one place.

filar1.naglowek: In the morning, you see who to reach out to.
filar1.korzysc: You have a plan for the day and a contact base that grows while you do the talking.
filar1.konkret1: The DMO sets the order of your conversations — you start the day without hesitating.
filar1.konkret2: A reminder just before each meeting — you walk in prepared, not caught off guard.
filar1.konkret3: Every referral arrives with a trail — you know who sent her your way.

filar2.naglowek: You write. Shield checks. Ethical Seal confirms.
filar2.korzysc: The Studio learns your voice and makes sure no piece of content breaks your rules.
filar2.konkret1: The Studio comes with ready formats and templates — you never face a blank page.
filar2.konkret2: The Shield flags risky wording before you hit send.
filar2.konkret3: The Ethical Seal gives a score and a certificate — proof, not just a feeling.

filar3.naglowek: A new team member knows what to do from day one
filar3.korzysc: Instead of explaining it all to every new person, the onboarding wizard does it for you.
filar3.konkret1: The onboarding wizard walks her through each stage — no help from you needed.
filar3.konkret2: First 90 Days: four phases with missions — she sees the road ahead of her.
filar3.konkret3: Achievements and badges keep her engaged long after the start.

filar4.naglowek: You see growth even after a hard day
filar4.korzysc: The Dashboard shows where things stand today, and your results carry proof that lasts.
filar4.konkret1: Your Wrapped sums up the period — you see what you actually got done.
filar4.konkret2: A goal with milestones tells you how far you’ve come and what’s next.
filar4.konkret3: The Testimony with its digital fingerprint stays — others can verify your results.

Cennik.naglowek: Plans differ in scope, not in promises
Cennik.wstep: Every plan is the same system. The difference is scope — from your first contacts to your whole team structure.

starter.dlaKogo: For you if you’re just starting and want a clear plan for every day.
starter.pozycja1: Dashboard — one screen where you see your contacts and results
starter.pozycja2: DMO — a Daily Action Plan that tells you what to do today
starter.pozycja3: Sign-up form with a public page — submissions go straight into your contact base
starter.pozycja4: Training Room — practice the hard answers before they come up for real
starter.pozycja5: Shield — catches risky wording before you send it

growth.dlaKogo: For you if you’re building a team and want to see how each of your people is doing.
growth.pozycja1: Team Pulse — you see the signs someone may be stepping back, with a ready line to open the conversation
growth.pozycja2: You see the full tree of your team structure

pro.dlaKogo: For you if you run a large structure and want to hand part of the work to others.
pro.pozycja1: Leaderboard — see where you stand among other users
pro.pozycja2: API keys and webhooks — connect Catherly to your own tools
pro.pozycja3: No limits on contacts, team, posts, and training sessions
pro.pozycja4: Clean export — your materials without a referral signature

faq.p1: Which currency will I pay in?
faq.o1: Prices on this page are in euros. Every plan also has a price in Polish złoty — you see the currency before you pay.
faq.p2: What if my plan stops being the right fit?
faq.o2: You choose a plan and change it whenever you like.
faq.p3: What if I decide it’s not for me?
faq.o3: You can cancel whenever you like. No reason needed.
faq.p4: What about my contacts when I cancel?
faq.o4: You export contacts to vCard and download your log as CSV — everything is yours.

Cennik.potwierdzenie2: Data export, always available: vCard and CSV

DbanieOSiebie.tresc: You collect proof of your work on the Wall of Proof. It’s a space where you celebrate, not just measure.

Problem.naglowek: Everything is somewhere. Each thing somewhere else.
Problem.tresc: You write posts once the house is asleep. In the morning you hunt for a number you know you saved somewhere. You hear what’s happening in your team later than you’d like.
Problem.kropka: In the evening you sit down with a notebook and add up what came of it.

Definicja.naglowek: Catherly is the memory of your selling
Definicja.tresc: Catherly remembers what you’ve been carrying in your head and your notebooks: what you promised to whom, which content went to which customer, and what sold. Your team is close at hand too — you see who you’re bringing in and how she’s doing. You still sell your way, just not from memory anymore.

RytmDnia.naglowek: What your day with Catherly looks like
RytmDnia.krok1Tresc: You open your Daily Action Plan and start conversations in a set order. The calendar reminds you of the rest.
RytmDnia.krok2Tresc: You check your contact base and know what you promised to whom. You build your post from a template in Studio.
RytmDnia.krok3Tresc: On the Dashboard, your day and your team’s day sit side by side.
RytmDnia.kropka: In the evening you see what came of it.

CennikSkrot.roznica: Every plan keeps track of your contacts and results — Growth adds a view of your whole team.

Obawy.p1: What if I can’t get the hang of another new app?
Obawy.o1: The onboarding wizard takes you step by step. First 90 Days gives you a ready plan for the start.
Obawy.p2: What about the contacts I already keep in other places?
Obawy.o2: There’s no bulk import — you add contacts by hand or through the form. You can always export them to vCard.
Obawy.p3: If I stop paying, does my data disappear?
Obawy.o3: You can cancel whenever you like. Export contacts to vCard, download your log as CSV — everything is yours.
Obawy.p4: I hold my customers’ data. Who else sees it?
Obawy.o4: Only you have access to your account. The Shield keeps content ethical — the SHA-256 Testimony logs every change.
Obawy.p5: I hardly ever sit at a computer — will this work?
Obawy.o5: Built for the phone from day one — there’s no cut-down version. You open it and it works the way it should.
Obawy.p6: My company has its rules. Can I even use outside tools?
Obawy.o6: The Compliance Passport scans content against four jurisdictions’ rules — but your company’s IT has the final say.

ZamkniecieGlowna.zdanie: You can cancel at any time.

ZamkniecieCennik.zdanie: Choose a plan and see how Catherly works in your day-to-day. Nothing ties you in — you can cancel whenever you like.

FunkcjeIndeks.h1: Features laid out the way your day runs
FunkcjeIndeks.zdanie: You choose what you need to do right now, and you’ll find the feature names along the way.
FunkcjeIndeks.blok1Naglowek: In the morning, you see who to reach out to.
FunkcjeIndeks.blok1Wprowadzenie: A day planned in the Daily Action Plan starts with something concrete. You keep your appointments, tasks and contacts in one place, not in your head.
FunkcjeIndeks.blok2Naglowek: You sit down to write your posts and don’t start from a blank page.
FunkcjeIndeks.blok2Wprowadzenie: You build your post from a ready template, plan it in the calendar and send it to your leader for approval — you do the publishing yourself. You catch risky wording before you publish, not after.
FunkcjeIndeks.blok3Naglowek: A new person joins your team, and you don’t explain it all over again.
FunkcjeIndeks.blok3Wprowadzenie: The onboarding wizard walks a new person through all the stages, and it’s you who guides her through First 90 Days, with its missions and phases. You approve your team’s content, and you check your message before you send it.
FunkcjeIndeks.blok4Naglowek: In the evening, you know where you stand.
FunkcjeIndeks.blok4Wprowadzenie: The Dashboard shows where things stand today, and your results carry proof that lasts. You record and celebrate your successes and your team’s before everyday life buries them.
FunkcjeIndeks.f8_1: Everything above works from the Starter plan up.
FunkcjeIndeks.f8_2: You don’t get the AI assistant on any plan.
FunkcjeIndeks.zamkniecieZdanie: You can cancel at any time.

FunkcjePozyskiwanie.naglowek: In the morning, you see who to reach out to.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.zdanie: You have a plan for the day and a contact base that grows while you do the talking.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod1_nazwa: Sign-up form with a public page
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod1_poco: A friend asks you about working together, and instead of copying her details out of your messages, you send her the link to your form. She fills it in on a public page — and the submission goes straight into your contact base.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod1_nie: Catherly won’t email you about a new submission — you see completed submissions in the app.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod2_poco: Your conversation dates don’t have to live in your head. You plan contacts in the calendar, and {minuty} minutes before each conversation Catherly reminds you about it.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod2_nie: Reminders don’t come by email or text message.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod3_poco: You glance at the calendar on your phone and see the conversations planned in Catherly next to everything else in your day. You don’t copy anything over — what you’ve planned is simply there.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod3_nie: The subscription works one way, toward your phone — Catherly doesn’t read your private calendar and takes nothing from it.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod4_poco: You’re heading to a meeting and want your customer’s number where it always is — on your phone. With one click you export your contacts to vCard, and you have them at hand even without opening the app.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod4_nie: The export works one way — there’s no bulk import; you add contacts by hand or through the form.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod5_poco: You finish a conversation and leave a business card — with your referral QR code on it instead of an address to retype. You create it in Catherly and add it to your materials and business cards when you export them.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod5_nie: Catherly doesn’t publish or send out materials with your code for you — you get a ready export, and you decide where the graphic or the printout goes.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod6_poco: You hand a friend an invitation with your code and get back to your day. You see in Catherly who used it — no need to keep asking whether anything came of it.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod6_nie: Catherly sends nothing to your friends — you pass the invitation on yourself, and the program only shows who used it.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod7_poco: A day planned in the Daily Action Plan starts with something concrete — you don’t wonder what’s next, you call, you write, you talk. Your plan carries you through the day.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod7_nie: The Daily Action Plan sends nothing for you — you call the people on your plan and write to them yourself.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod8_poco: After a conversation you save a task with the person it concerns: call back after the weekend, send the catalog, ask about the decision. You come back to the contact, and what you agreed is right there with it.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod8_nie: Catherly won’t remind you about a task by email — your task list is in the app.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod9_poco: Before a hard conversation, you step into the Training Room and give it a dry run — the objection comes up here first, not in front of your customer. You take your answers from a library of objections sorted into seven categories.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod9_nie: The Training Room doesn’t talk to your customer and sends her nothing — you practice here on your own, and it’s you who leads the real conversation.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod10_poco: Before a meeting you write down a conversation plan: what you’ll ask, what you’ll show, what matters to you. After the meeting you write a debrief — the details go into the note before the rest of the day pushes them out.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod10_nie: Catherly won’t write the plan or the debrief for you — you write them yourself, in your own words.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.aiTresc: With the AI assistant, you tailor messages to a specific person.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.aiGranica: The assistant won’t write the text for you — it suggests, you write.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.f8_1: Everything above works from the Starter plan up.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.f8_2: You don’t get the AI assistant on any plan.
FunkcjePozyskiwanie.zamkniecieZdanie: You can cancel at any time.

FunkcjeTresci.naglowek: You write. Shield checks. Ethical Seal confirms.
FunkcjeTresci.zdanie: The Studio learns your voice and makes sure no piece of content breaks your rules.
FunkcjeTresci.mod1_poco: The same idea has to look good in a post and in print — and you don’t want to start from scratch every time. That’s what the Studio is for: safe zones and auto-layout make sure nothing important gets cut off in any format.
FunkcjeTresci.mod1_nie: You can’t upload photos from your phone to the Studio — you put a design together from text, templates, and the editor’s elements.
FunkcjeTresci.mod2_poco: In the evening, you prepare a post, and instead of a blank page you open a ready template. You swap in your text, save your own version — and next time you start from that one.
FunkcjeTresci.mod2_nie: Catherly won’t generate a template for you — you pick a ready one and adjust it your way.
FunkcjeTresci.mod3_poco: You put a hashtag set together once and have it at hand for every post — you add it with one click. You don’t retype anything from old posts or from the notes on your phone.
FunkcjeTresci.mod3_nie: Catherly won’t suggest hashtags for you — you decide what’s in a set and which post it goes with.
FunkcjeTresci.mod4_poco: Every post idea gets its place and date in the calendar right away. You see what you’ve planned and for when, and when plans change, you move a post to another day — without rebuilding everything from scratch.
FunkcjeTresci.mod4_nie: Catherly won’t publish a post for you — the calendar shows the plan, and you do the publishing yourself.
FunkcjeTresci.mod5_poco: You send a finished post for approval — from that moment it’s with your leader. When she accepts or rejects it, you see it right away — no chasing her in messages.
FunkcjeTresci.mod5_nie: Catherly won’t email you about your leader’s decision — you see the status in the app.
FunkcjeTresci.mod6_poco: You catch risky wording before you publish, not after. The Shield’s rules run inside the app itself — your content never leaves it to be checked.
FunkcjeTresci.mod6_nie: The Shield won’t fix the text for you — it points out risky wording, and what you do with it is your decision.
FunkcjeTresci.mod7_poco: You finish a design, and it gets the Ethical Seal — an ethical score with a public certificate. At a meeting you show your customer the QR code: she scans it and sees the certificate for herself.
FunkcjeTresci.mod7_nie: Catherly won’t send the certificate to your customer — who sees it and when is your decision.
FunkcjeTresci.mod8_poco: You write posts the way you talk to your customers — in your own way. Catherly learns that style from your published posts and builds your brand’s voice profile from it.
FunkcjeTresci.mod8_nie: Catherly won’t write your posts for you — the voice profile remembers your style, and you do the writing yourself, in your own words.
FunkcjeTresci.mod9_poco: You come back to your posts after a few days and don’t have to guess where you left off. You filter the board and see right away what’s waiting for approval and what you’ve already scheduled.
FunkcjeTresci.mod9_nie: The board won’t show reach or likes — you see the status of your posts, and you check their results where you published them.
FunkcjeTresci.aiTresc: With the AI assistant, you write and edit content — it suggests, you decide.
FunkcjeTresci.aiGranica: The assistant won’t write the content for you — it offers ideas and edits, and you write.
FunkcjeTresci.f8_1: Everything above works from the Starter plan up.
FunkcjeTresci.f8_2: You don’t get the AI assistant on any plan.
FunkcjeTresci.zamkniecieZdanie: You can cancel at any time.

FunkcjeZespol.naglowek: A new team member knows what to do from day one
FunkcjeZespol.zdanie: Instead of explaining it all to every new person, the onboarding wizard does it for you.
FunkcjeZespol.mod1_poco: A friend has decided to join your team, and your day is already full of your own conversations. You don’t sit down with her to go over every setting — the onboarding wizard walks her through six steps, from her profile and goals to a ready start.
FunkcjeZespol.mod1_nie: The wizard doesn’t move data over from other tools — the new person enters her profile and goals in it herself, step by step.
FunkcjeZespol.mod2_poco: Someone on your team has finished a post and is waiting to hear what you think. You approve it or reject it — and the whole structure sees the status change right away.
FunkcjeZespol.mod2_nie: Catherly won’t publish an approved post for you or for anyone on your team — approval changes the status, and the author publishes the content herself.
FunkcjeZespol.mod3_poco: A new person asks you what’s next — and you don’t build her plan from scratch. You guide her through First 90 Days: missions tell her what to do now, and four phases show her where she’s heading.
FunkcjeZespol.mod3_nie: Catherly won’t guide the new person for you — the program gives her missions and phases, and it’s you who leads the conversations.
FunkcjeZespol.mod4_poco: A colleague on your team comes back after a break, and her streak doesn’t start over from zero — a grace token protects it. For the steps that follow, she collects badges and sees that her daily work counts.
FunkcjeZespol.mod4_nie: Catherly won’t let you design your own badges or the rules for earning them — your team collects achievements according to ready-made rules.
FunkcjeZespol.mod5_poco: What you’re allowed to write in one market can be off-limits in another — and you don’t have to keep those differences in your head. You check your message against four jurisdictions’ rules in the Compliance Passport before you send it.
FunkcjeZespol.mod5_nie: The Compliance Passport gives no legal guarantee and no legal advice — the scanner checks your message against the rules, and you decide for yourself what you send.
FunkcjeZespol.mod6_poco: A new person on your team opens the Academy and doesn’t ask you where to start — the next module unlocks only once the previous one is finished. You get back to your own conversations, and her path takes care of itself.
FunkcjeZespol.mod6_nie: Catherly doesn’t come with ready-made training content — the Academy looks after the order of the modules, not what’s inside them.
FunkcjeZespol.f8_1: Everything above works from the Starter plan up.
FunkcjeZespol.f8_2: On the Growth plan, you see the signs someone may be stepping back, with a ready line to open the conversation.
FunkcjeZespol.f8_3: On the Growth plan, you see the full tree of your team structure.
FunkcjeZespol.zamkniecieZdanie: You can cancel at any time.

FunkcjeWyniki.naglowek: You see growth even after a hard day
FunkcjeWyniki.zdanie: The Dashboard shows where things stand today, and your results carry proof that lasts.
FunkcjeWyniki.mod1_poco: On the Dashboard you see where things stand right now: sales, active contacts, your team’s activity — all in one place. Before you decide what matters most today, you know where you stand.
FunkcjeWyniki.mod1_nie: The Dashboard doesn’t show data from outside Catherly — you see what you and your team record in the app.
FunkcjeWyniki.mod2_poco: You open Your Wrapped and read a summary of your period: what you did, what you sold, what was going on in your team. You see what actually happened — not just what you remember.
FunkcjeWyniki.mod2_nie: Catherly won’t turn your summary into a PDF report — you view Your Wrapped in the app.
FunkcjeWyniki.mod3_poco: You set a goal and track your progress milestone by milestone. Instead of one distant finish line, you see how far you’ve come and what’s next.
FunkcjeWyniki.mod3_nie: Catherly doesn’t set goals for you and doesn’t push you when progress slows — the goal is yours, and so is the pace.
FunkcjeWyniki.mod4_poco: A new person’s first sale, the milestone you closed — you save moments like these on the Success wall. You record and celebrate your successes and your team’s before everyday life buries them.
FunkcjeWyniki.mod4_nie: Catherly won’t record a success for you — what lands on the Success wall, you put there yourself.
FunkcjeWyniki.mod5_poco: You want to show your results to someone who hasn’t seen your day-to-day work. You export a CSV from the Testimony whenever you like — and the log with its SHA-256 digital fingerprint means your activity history can be verified, not just read.
FunkcjeWyniki.mod5_nie: The Testimony sends nothing anywhere — you see the log, and the CSV goes only to the people you yourself hand it to.
FunkcjeWyniki.mod6_poco: You collect proof of your work on the Wall of Proof — your personal timeline of successes. On a harder day, you scroll through it and see how much is already behind you — it’s a space where you celebrate, not just measure.
FunkcjeWyniki.mod6_nie: The Wall of Proof isn’t the team’s wall — celebrating together has its place on the Success wall.
FunkcjeWyniki.f8_1: Everything above works from the Starter plan up.
FunkcjeWyniki.f8_2: On the Growth plan, you see the signs someone may be stepping back, with a ready line to open the conversation.
FunkcjeWyniki.zamkniecieZdanie: You can cancel at any time.

DlaKogo.naglowek: You’re working on your own, you’re building a team, or you’re running a structure.
DlaKogo.zdanie: Each path has a different hard part, a different job for Catherly — and a different place where it stops.
DlaKogo.ctaZdanie: You can cancel at any time.
DlaKogo.s1_h2: You still keep it all in your head and in your messages.
DlaKogo.s1_boli: Every morning you decide from scratch where to start: your notes are on your phone, what you agreed is in your messages, and your conversation dates sit in several places at once. In the evening, you’re not sure whether you’ve forgotten someone important.
DlaKogo.s1_robi_1: You set the order of your conversations in the <dmo>Daily Action Plan</dmo> — you start the day with something concrete instead of hesitating. You put your conversation dates into the <kalendarz>calendar with reminders</kalendarz> — {minuty} minutes before each conversation Catherly reminds you about it.
DlaKogo.s1_robi_2: When someone asks you about working together, you pass on the link to your <formularz>sign-up form</formularz> — the completed submission goes straight into your contact base. You give a hard conversation a dry run in the <salaTreningowa>Training Room</salaTreningowa> first.
DlaKogo.s1_robi_3: You start a post from a <szablony>ready template</szablony>, not from a blank page. The <tarcza>Shield</tarcza> points out risky wording before you publish.
DlaKogo.s1_plan: Everything above works from the Starter plan up.
DlaKogo.s1_granica: Catherly won’t find contacts for you and won’t lead your conversations — you send people to the form yourself, and what you get in return is order in your day.
DlaKogo.s2_h2: You have a team. The question is who to help today and who not to disturb.
DlaKogo.s2_boli: Everyone on your team is in a different place: one is only just settling in, another has slowed down after a good start. You don’t have it on one screen, so you find out in conversation — usually later than you’d like.
DlaKogo.s2_robi_1: The <pulpit>Dashboard</pulpit> shows where things stand right now: sales, active contacts, your team’s activity — all in one place. You bring a new person in through the <kreator>onboarding wizard</kreator>: profile, goals, materials, invitation.
DlaKogo.s2_robi_2: Then you guide her through <pierwsze90>First 90 Days</pierwsze90>: missions tell her what to do now, and four phases show her where she’s heading. <osiagniecia>Achievements</osiagniecia> run on ready-made rules: your team collects badges for the steps that follow, and when a colleague comes back after a break, a grace token protects her streak.
DlaKogo.s2_plan_1: Everything above works from the Starter plan up.
DlaKogo.s2_plan_2: On the Growth plan, you see the signs someone may be stepping back, with a ready line to open the conversation.
DlaKogo.s2_granica: Catherly won’t decide for you who has slowed down — you see only what you and your team record in the app, and it’s you who leads the conversation.
DlaKogo.s3_h2: The structure has grown, and the decisions still come through you.
DlaKogo.s3_boli: Questions from new people, content waiting to hear what you think, the uncertainty about what you’re allowed to write in which market — every one of them is waiting for you. The week doesn’t get any longer.
DlaKogo.s3_robi_1: <zatwierdzanieZespolu>Team content approval</zatwierdzanieZespolu> sits with you: you approve a post or reject it, and the whole structure sees the status change right away. The <paszport>Compliance Passport</paszport> checks your message against four jurisdictions’ rules before you send it — you don’t have to keep the differences between markets in your head.
DlaKogo.s3_robi_2: In the <akademia>Academy</akademia>, the next module unlocks only once the previous one is finished — a new person doesn’t ask you where to start, and an administrator adds the training content.
DlaKogo.s3_plan_1: Everything above works from the Starter plan up.
DlaKogo.s3_plan_2: On the Growth plan, you see the full tree of your team structure.
DlaKogo.s3_plan_3: Clean export — your materials without a referral signature — is on the Pro plan.
DlaKogo.s3_granica: The Compliance Passport gives no legal guarantee and no legal advice — it checks your message against the rules, and the approvals and the conversations with people stay with you.
